seo.title: Cheezy Bites Karama | 24-Hour Pakistani Food, Shawarma, Pizza & Burgers
seo.description: Cheezy Bites, Era Building, 4A Street, Al Karama: Pakistani karahi and biryani, shawarma platters, pizza, shami burgers and loaded fries. Open 24 hours, dine-in and delivery. 4.8 from 898 reviews.

hero.lede: Pakistani karahi, biryani and chargha next to cheesy pizzas, shawarma platters, shami burgers and loaded fries. Open 24 hours, seven days, for dine-in, takeaway and delivery.
